WITH totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_addresses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT city_id) AS num_cities
  FROM address
),
city_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    city_id,
    COUNT(*) AS address_count
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
)
SELECT 
  city_counts.city_id,
  city_counts.address_count,
  CAST(city_counts.address_count AS FLOAT) / (CAST(totals.total_addresses AS FLOAT) / totals.num_cities) AS count_div_avg,
  CAST(city_counts.address_count AS FLOAT) / totals.total_addresses AS share_of_total
FROM city_counts
CROSS JOIN totals
ORDER BY share_of_total DESC
LIMIT 10
